name: 5-(2,3-Dihydro-1-benzofuran-7-yl)-3-methyl-8-nitro-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-3-benzazepin-7-ol
summary: NNC 01-0687 (also known as ADX-10061, CEE-03-310, or NNC-687) is a selective dopamine D1-like receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was under development as an experimental antipsychotic for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. Its development for schizophrenia was discontinued due to lack of effectiveness in clinical trials.

pharmacology.text: NNC 01-0687 (also known as ADX-10061, CEE-03-310, or NNC-687) is a selective dopamine D1-like receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was under development as an experimental antipsychotic for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed.

uses.text: NNC 01-0687 (also known as ADX-10061, CEE-03-310, or NNC-687) is a selective dopamine D1-like receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was under development as an experimental antipsychotic for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. Its development for schizophrenia was discontinued due to lack of effectiveness in clinical trials. It was also developed for treatment of sleep disorders.

fact.en: It belongs to the benzazepine family, the same group as SCH-23390, the classic research drug used to block dopamine D1 receptors.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并氮呯類，和用來阻斷多巴胺 D1 受體的經典研究藥物 SCH-23390 同一類。
